I am trying to run the code below for latent regression model, and my Y does not have any missing cases. When I tried,  I receive the error message saying "Error in t(X) %*% scores". My understanding is that after removing rows with NAs in covdata, the dimension of covdata differs from the dimension of Y. 

Could you please let me know how to tackle this?
Thanks in advance!!

lrm_dum <- mirt(
  data = Y,  ##          
  model = 1,    
  itemtype = "2PL",
  covdata =  bq1dat_dum,  ##
  formula = f,
  pars = scaling_s,...)

Hi Hyo Jeong,

This looks to have been a bug. The patch is currently available on the dev version, though I'll be releasing the next version of mirt sometime later this month. Sorry for the delayed reply.

Phil
